voided_reason: Item withdrawn. The mention was extracted from a TEI mis-segmentation: on facsimile page 379 of volume 1 (printed pp. 725-726) a paragraph belonging to the previous entry was attached to the following <div type="entry">, so the host 'Wysocki, Ida' (P-1-facs_379_r_152) was credited with another woman's biography. The mention's host attribution is therefore unsound, and the mention itself is part of an organisation name (Adler-Sierocki's Scala Theatre), not a bare person reference. R2-0032 was reassigned to a different mention on 2026-11-25.
